text: opened the forest of warthunder for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; a contrary room

B1d room warthunder (order 273, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 15 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (54 threads). Moved: t15 (filtering and policing the meme surge) from T3-063 to T3-185. It is the moderators and members working out the new meme rule that t14 announced in the same thread (635l4o): a meme flair and a no-memes filter, votes instead of removal, objections, and two irrelevant memes removed (c0112 to c0135). None of its posts is about the canvas, so T3-063 does not hold it; it is the doing T3-185 holds in habs and furry_irl. tier_history line written (members_changed, T3-063 to T3-185). The rest hold: Gaijin's Rank IX joke recognised, played, taught, weighed and read as a test (t01 to t04, t06, t07 T3-048), asking Gaijin to keep it (t05 T3-100), the member's Ka-Ha fake (t08 T3-001 with T3-095), the hammer and sickle accepted as the room's spot (t09 T3-175 with T3-033), canvas plans and the failed blue-corner invasion (t10 T3-033 with T3-006 and T3-031), the logo call (t11 T3-002 with T3-016), the A6M moved, refused by hosts and restarted (t13 bag under T3-022) and the rule change itself (t14 T3-185). t12 stays unplaced (a bare title). Read plainly: 'There's a Soviet Hammer and Sickle around (20, 429)' answered 'Good enough comrade!' (c0060, c0061); a T-34 with 'Russian bias' proposed for the blue corner (c0064); r/ireland's thread as the place to ask before building (c0083, c0084); r/japan, r/ainbowroad and r/italy asked for room (c0093). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: every host it asked refused or did not answer. No new kind; the run is not reset.

What and where to build (t01 bag under T3-065), defence calls (t02 T3-005), neutrality, borders and pacts (t03 bag under T3-138), the one current plan (t04 T3-091 with T3-051), the Discord, its decisions and the Void's Discord joined to spy (t05 T3-014 with T3-152 and T3-132), repair against bots (t06 T3-021 with T3-028 and T3-141), the recounting (t07 T3-073 with T3-050), thanks (t08 T3-009), the memorial list (t09 T3-043 with T3-003) and the dinner invitation (t10 T3-186) hold every concept. c0097 (multiple accounts) is one peripheral concept in t09. Read plainly: a Savoyard flag to be attacked and made Swiss (c0109); a border proposal sent to r/de over France (c0012); a 3-Länder-Eck with France and Germany (c0065); a réduit (c0010); a Swiss heart because Togo, North Korea, Tonga and Mongolia have one (c0048); 'DEFEND SCHWEIZ' (c0043); helping the American flag argued as not neutral and as 'the most swiss thing to do' (c0112 to c0114); a warning that organised vandals were trying to set the room and MonaLisaClan against each other (thread 62zoso, c0057). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the name did not describe its conduct. No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room masseffect (order 281, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 13 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (55 threads). No change. Calls to build and defend (t01 T3-002 with T3-005), the pixel work (t02 T3-038 with T3-021 and T3-070), Garrus, the Initiative logo and protective borders (t03 T3-041 with T3-055), the relocations (t04 T3-022 with T3-024), the deals with Tamadra, TWD, the taskbar and the WIT group (t05 bag under T3-010), watching attacks (t06 T3-005 with T3-136), the Discords and the envoy (t07 T3-014 with T3-153 and T3-194), orienting others (t08 T3-016 with T3-082 and T3-052), celebration and mourning (t09 bag under T3-009), the Mass Effect jokes (t10 T3-031), the Andromeda April Fools (t11 T3-001 with T3-095), the title-tag removals (t12 T3-063) and the pushback (t13 T3-037 with T3-075) hold every concept. The T3-188 doing shows once: a member from r/2007scape offering to help rebuild while warning that with several RuneScape subs working together no single person is in charge (c0124, one concept in t04). National content read plainly: the Netherlands expanding into a proposed site (c0012); 'the World Congress' that might have been swayed against the taskbar (c0236). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the room moved and accepted the rival's help, though some urged fighting back (c0052, c0238). No new kind; the run is not reset.

opened the forest of finland for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; a contrary room

B1d room finland (order 291, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 7 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (30 threads). One change: t04 (pushing back on the expanding Finnish flag) held three kinds (T3-076 with T3-081 and T3-087) and the reread finds a fourth carried by concepts of its own: members telling the Bears and others that the eastward expansion is not the organised effort, that no known group owns it and that 'some random botter' is doing it (c0032, c0033, c0039), the T3-188 doing. By rule 0 it is now a bag: placed once in T3-076 (members stopping the expansion with spare pixels and objecting to it, c0035, c0037, c0038), with T3-188, T3-087 (outsiders naming Finland for breaking the Square Spiral truce and the Bears' logo, c0070, c0071) and T3-081 (what Finland will do to Russia, Greater Finland, c0040, c0078) in out/_analysis/b1d03_bags_finland.txt; T3-081 and T3-087 unplaced, 2 tier_history lines (dropping), bag checked. t02's c0007 ('people are uncontrollable', said by the Argentine proposer of the Square Spiral boundary) is the same doing in one concept. The rest hold: peace offers and alliances (t01 T3-150 with T3-149 and T3-072), borders, truces and who gets room (t02 T3-010 with T3-149 and T3-151), calls to defend, repair or attack flags (t03 bag under T3-005), emblems inside the flag (t05 T3-113 with T3-068 and T3-088), routing canvas talk (t06 bag under T3-015) and the aftermath (t07 T3-073 with T3-029). Read plainly: 'Suur-Suomi must prevail' (c0078) and 'what we will do to Russia' (c0040); help asked against 'the brutal swedish hordes' for the Danish flag (c0012); a call to take over Norway's flag (c0087); Estonia's and Åland's flags helped (c0073, c0076); Pakistan asking help (c0059); Kekkonen identified on the flag (c0074); an equality flag proposed and refused (c0051 to c0053); a Viking ship above the UK (c0020). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: outsiders came here to negotiate and were sent to r/Suomi. No new kind; the run is not reset.

correction to the finland room note: c0007 is not said by the proposer. r/SquareSpiral's member proposed the boundary (c0006); c0007 is r/Argentina's member approving it while doubting that all of SquareSpiral's people will heed it. That is the other side of the doing, a room doubting a neighbour's control of its placers, as in PinkVomitMonster c0005, not a room disowning its own.

B1d room Thegreatblackhole (order 297, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 10 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (56 threads). No change. The 'paint it black' and 'consume' chants (t01 T3-171), the void as a calling (t02 T3-174 with T3-031), tendrils and a pure middle (t03 T3-004), posters and the refused sign (t04 T3-044 with T3-169), the Discord and the migration to r/theblackvoid (t05 T3-090 with T3-014 and T3-109), bargaining over who is spared (t06 bag under T3-010), keeping art inside the void (t07 T3-024), coordinates and switching accounts (t08 T3-070 with T3-088), naming who will be consumed (t09 T3-006 with T3-050) and the mourning with bots blamed (t10 T3-029 with T3-027 and T3-009) hold every concept. Read plainly: 'Not even the Nazis destroyed art, they only stole it' (c0061); a call not to let the trans road take over, put in a slur (c0052), and the war with the transflag kept up (c0060); 'PURPLE IS TRYING TO INVADE. PURIFY' (c0051); the European flag to be swallowed (c0042, c0048) and 'consume the Swiss next', answered with free transit through the Alps and gold storage (c0049, c0076). The A1 note's 'not this', as qualified at catch-up, holds: sparing art was argued, not the rule. No new kind; the run is not reset.
